title: `near dev-deploy` is used but the Node near CLI no longer has it
summary: Older tutorials deploy with `near dev-deploy` (or `near dev deploy`). The Node near-cli 4.0.13 command list has no such command, so scripts and instructions copied from them fail.
message: `near dev-deploy` appears in {file}:{line}; near-cli 4.0.13 (checked) has no such command.

steps: Create a funded testnet account: `near create-account <account-id>.testnet --useFaucet`.

evidence.observed: Checked 2026-11-13: `near --help` for near-cli 4.0.13 lists add-credentials, call, create-account, delete-account, deploy, generate-key, state, view and others, and no dev-deploy. The NEAR docs show `near create-account <account-id> --useFaucet` and `near deploy <account-id> <wasm-file>`.
